no_approved_devices.title: Ambientika listener is closed
no_approved_devices.description: No device is approved and no enrollment window is active, so the integration has closed all TCP listeners. Open the integration options, add an owned device ID or start a five-minute enrollment window, then explicitly approve the expected candidate.

wildcard_listener.title: Ambientika listens on every network interface
wildcard_listener.description: The listener uses 0.0.0.0 or ::. If possible, select the Home Assistant IP on the fan network. Otherwise restrict TCP 11000 with firewall rules so only owned fans can reach it.
